reprintable_value.detail: 14.5% of rare+ value sits in cards Wizards may reprint (Reserved List share 85.5%)

chase_concentration.detail: top card carries 85.5% of rare+ value; a single reprint of it moves EV most

unreprinted_share.detail: 0.0% of value in cards printed only once (fresh reprint targets)

set_type.detail: set type 'promo' (VINTAGE_ERA); UB and masterpiece sets historically see fewer like-for-like reprints

age.detail: 344 months since release; reprint sensitivity of sealed prices fades as boxes become collectibles

method: Weighted scorecard, 0 safe to 100 exposed. Inputs are MTGJSON printing counts and Reserved List flags, observed TCGplayer prices, set type and age. Weights: reprintable value 35%, chase concentration 20%, unreprinted share 15%, set type 15%, age 15%. This is a transparent heuristic, not a fitted probability.
